title: Collapsing Flat ${\rm{SU}}(2)$-Bundles to Spherical 3-Manifolds
summary: We present a geometric mechanism for the emergence of spherical $3$-manifolds from the superspace of Riemannian metrics associated with flat ${\rm{SU}}(2)$-bundles over closed orientable hyperbolic surfaces. Our main result shows that any homogeneous spherical 3-manifold $(S,g_{S})$ can be realized as a boundary point in the Gromov-Hausdorff closure of a superspace $\mathcal{S}(P)$, where $P$ is a flat ${\rm{SU}}(2)$-bundle over a closed orientable hyperbolic surface $(Σ,h_Σ)$.
